listModels.title: List models
listModels.summary: Lists the models currently available through aio-proxy.
listModels.description: Lists the models currently available through aio-proxy. Try It runs in your browser, so the selected server must allow cross-origin requests; browser local-network access controls may also apply. From an HTTPS documentation page, insecure remote HTTP servers are blocked as mixed content, while loopback addresses such as `http://127.0.0.1` and `http://localhost` are treated as secure local resources.
listModels.note: Agent negotiation and client_version catalogs are excluded from this page.

createChatCompletion.title: Create a chat completion
createChatCompletion.summary: Creates a chat completion with the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API.
createChatCompletion.description: Creates a chat completion with the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Set `stream: true` to receive a streaming response. Requests are parsed against this endpoint's schema. A same-protocol provider with raw capability receives the raw-forwarded request after routing rewrites; cross-protocol and AI SDK providers receive a converted model request, so fields that cannot be represented by the target protocol are not forwarded. Try It runs in your browser, so the selected server must allow cross-origin requests; browser local-network access controls may also apply. From an HTTPS documentation page, insecure remote HTTP servers are blocked as mixed content, while loopback addresses such as `http://127.0.0.1` and `http://localhost` are treated as secure local resources. Try It sends the request, but Scalar does not provide a separate streaming debugger; use the SSE example when the panel does not render events.
